Klecks algorithms

Source: https://github.com/bitbof/klecks
Revision: b86ba7d0edb2c48ad21ca58aae4775fccf329632
License: MIT. See LICENSE in this directory.

Sniptale adapts floodFillBits, BezierLine, and their required private helpers.
Sniptale also adapts eraser stamp spacing and synchronous segment finalization.
The provenance.json file records source paths, hashes, and changes.

Sniptale owns the visibility planes, independent hardness, Restore mode, and clipping.
The adaptation does not include the upstream UI, Canvas owner, or history owner.
